item.title: $37.7 million for key dairy freight routes
item.description: Around 392,000 cows produce 2.05 billion litres of milk annually across over 1000 farms in Victoria’s southwest. Image: 169169/stock.adobe.com Six kilometres of roads in Australia’s largest dairy production area will be upgraded under a $37.7 million program. The Dairy Supply Chain Road Upgrades project will deliver upgrades to roads along Cobden-Stonyford Road, Bullaharre, and Princes Highway West at Pirron Yallock, southwest of Melbourne.
